components.css: .ds-search{font-family:"Geist Variable", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;height:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line, #2d2e34);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-muted, #8d8d95);background:var(--control, #18191d)} .ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent, #776ac5)} .ds-search input{font-family:"Geist Variable", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;min-width:0;flex:1;border:0;outline:0;color:var(--ink, #e8e8eb);background:transparent;font-size:14px} .ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--placeholder, #898991)}

components.name: Calendar chip
components.description: Compact calendar record with a title action and date control; native keyboard focus is retained.
components.css: .ds-chip{font-family:"Geist Variable", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;width:100%;padding:2px;border:1px solid var(--line, #2d2e34);border-radius:5px;color:var(--text-soft, #b9b9c0);background:var(--surface, #202126);font-size:12px;text-align:left;cursor:grab} .ds-chip:hover{color:var(--text-strong, #e8e8eb);border-color:var(--line-strong, #45464e);background:var(--hover, #212228)} .ds-chip-open{font-family:"Geist Variable", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;min-width:0;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 5px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer} .ds-chip-title{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap} .ds-chip-date{width:25px;min-width:25px;height:24px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-size:0;cursor:pointer} .ds-chip-date::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator{margin:0;cursor:pointer} .ds-chip.dragging{opacity:.45} .ds-chip.schedule-blocked{cursor:wait;opacity:.62}

components.name: Weekly card
components.description: A working title, labelled status, and native schedule selector; native keyboard focus is retained.
components.css: .ds-card{font-family:"Geist Variable", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:grid;gap:7px;margin-bottom:5px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #45464e);border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface, #202126);cursor:grab} .ds-card:hover{background:var(--hover, #212228)} .ds-card.dragging{opacity:.45} .ds-card.schedule-blocked{cursor:wait;opacity:.62} .ds-card-open{font-family:"Geist Variable", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:block;min-width:0;min-height:44px;width:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text-strong, #e8e8eb);text-align:left;cursor:pointer} .ds-card-open strong{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:550;overflow-wrap:anywhere} .ds-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:7px;color:var(--text-muted, #8d8d95);font-size:11px} .ds-dot{width:6px;height:6px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:50%;background:#918f86} .ds-card-select{font-family:"Geist Variable", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;width:100%;min-height:30px;padding:0 4px;border:1px solid var(--line, #2d2e34);border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-soft, #b9b9c0);background:var(--control, #18191d);font-size:11px} @media(max-width:600px){.ds-card-select{min-height:44px}}

narrative.overview:
ContentFlow uses compact Geist typography, closely spaced neutral surfaces, fine borders, and violet state accents. Planning views keep counts, titles, statuses, and controls visible together; the writing view gives the document more space.

This record describes the implemented UI in apps/web/src/styles.css, WeeklyMatrix.tsx, App.tsx, content-meta.tsx, and Calendar.tsx, checked against the desktop and mobile captures in .impeccable/review. The stylesheet remains the implementation source of truth.
keyCharacteristics: Dark and light themes share semantic color roles.
Flat planning surfaces use borders and tonal changes for grouping.
Compact controls retain text labels beside status and format icons.
The weekly matrix scrolls horizontally while row labels remain visible.

rules.name: The Shared Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the theme accent for primary actions, ready state, current-day marks, target progress, and explicit selection or focus treatments.

rules.name: The Flat Planning Rule
rules.body: Planning cards and containers use borders and tonal surfaces at rest. Outer shadows belong to the existing modal and mobile drawer layers.

dos: Do use the existing semantic CSS variables so both themes keep the same roles.
Do pair status dots with text labels and keep platform icons neutral.
Do reuse the compact control and card shapes recorded here.
Do preserve keyboard scrolling and sticky row labels in the weekly matrix.
Do use the existing native day selector alongside drag interactions.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent for content formats.
Don't use floating card shadows in the weekly plan.
Don't hide the remaining days by clipping the weekly matrix.
Don't encode status through color alone.
